library_preparation_preflight.summary: Standard Oracle JDBC Azure SPI provider module; Azure SDK deps are already transitive on the artifact's own POM, and meaningful coverage (ServiceLoader-discovered provider classes, parameter/builder metadata) doesn't require live Azure resources or a Docker emulator, matching precedent from software.amazon.awssdk:secretsmanager and com.oracle.oci.sdk tests in this repo.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: This library exposes OracleResourceProvider/OracleConfigurationProvider SPI implementations for Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, and Azure AD/Entra ID token auth, discovered via META-INF/services. Favor tests that exercise ServiceLoader discovery and provider metadata (getName(), getParameters()) and builder/parameter-parsing classes over tests that attempt live Azure calls — no com.azure Docker emulator is available in this repo and full token/secret retrieval against real Azure resources cannot be exercised here.
risks: End-to-end paths that actually authenticate against Azure AD or fetch secrets from Key Vault/App Configuration cannot be exercised without live cloud credentials, so coverage will likely be limited to provider registration, parameter parsing, and builder configuration rather than full request/response flows.
